max_attempts.description: How many times the job may RUN in total — the original run plus its retries. 3 means three runs and two retries; the job dead-letters when the third run fails.

max_retries.description: DEPRECATED — use max_attempts, which carries the identical value. This field never held a retry count: it has always capped total runs. Kept on the wire for one release so consumers can migrate; removed after that.
